_comment: P2-056 (GPU 3.91; judges: Stormwood uniformed officers 'are small dark figures lost against dark green-teal grass, with no rim light or uniform accent to pick them out'). When enabled, scripts/world/stormwood_character_rim.gd gives every Stormwood person and trainer body a cool fresnel backlight edge (shaders/character_rim_overlay.gdshader, material overlay, additive, no shadows). Client presentation only; no other realm. CPU r1 at energy 0.45 / power 3.0 read only up close; the post-view figures are small, so 0.75 / 2.4. OFF until GPU judged.

r2._why: Visual lane (3 Nov 2026), F41#18: r1 (0.75 / 2.4) judged CPU v1/b11 5.58 -> 5.98 (officer reads pale grey in A, still no rank read). r2 widens and brightens the edge so small post-view figures separate from the moss. Only energy and power change. OFF until judged.
